heading: Grants and loans to Indian tribes and nonprofit organizations representing ethnic or minority groups
lead: The Secretary may, in consultation with the appropriate State Historic Preservation Officer, make grants or loans or both under this subdivision to Indian tribes and to nonprofit organizations representing ethnic or minority groups for the preservation of their cultural heritage.
